mapper.sql: notification_id AS notificationId, account_id AS accountId, event_id AS eventId, category, symbol, title, body, channel, status, read_at AS readAt, created_at AS createdAt
mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id AS "orderId", o.account_id AS "accountId", o.ticker AS "symbol", o.side AS "side", o.quantity AS "quantity", o.price AS "price", o.executed_price AS "executedPrice", o.status AS "status", o.rejection_reason AS "reason" FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('FILLED', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELLED') AND (o.executed_on >= #{since} OR o.received_at >= #{since}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM notification n WHERE n.event_id = 'order-' || o.order_id || '-ORDER_' || o.status OR (n.account_id = o.account_id AND n.category = 'ORDER_' || o.status AND n.body LIKE 'Order ' || o.order_id || ' %')) ORDER BY o.order_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (account_id, event_id, category, symbol, title, body, channel, status) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{eventId}, #{category}, #{symbol}, #{title}, #{body}, #{channel}, #{status})
